query: SELECT r.id, r.task_id, r.created_at, r.version FROM central.runs r JOIN central.recovery_epoch_workspaces w ON w.epoch_generation = $1 AND w.workspace_id = r.workspace_id JOIN central.recovery_epochs e ON e.epoch_generation = w.epoch_generation AND e.coordinator_domain = $6 WHERE r.workspace_id = $2 AND r.reconciled_epoch < $1 AND (r.created_at < w.watermark_created_at OR (r.created_at = w.watermark_created_at AND r.id <= w.watermark_run_id)) AND ($3::timestamptz IS NULL OR r.created_at > $3::timestamptz OR (r.created_at = $3::timestamptz AND r.id > $4::uuid)) ORDER BY r.created_at, r.id LIMIT $5
